page.overview:
Who is Evoroa?

https://bsky.app/profile/ariadne-mouse.bsky.social/post/3l2ydbqxnu22d}}

is a bormodo scientist and a Volition ally and spy. As an NPC, she is played by Matthew Mercer.

Like other bormodos, Evoroa has a squat figure, with one set of long, muscular arms and a second set of shorter arms with smaller hands. Her head is set between broad, rounded shoulders, such that it was unclear whether she had a neck. She has a wide, pulled-back mouth. She also has, characteristic of bormodos, dark eyes and a nose that is little more than a bump with slits.

Evoroa was a scientist of the Colloquium of Candescense. In 843 PD, when Ludinus Da'leth and his Ruby Vanguard arrived on Ruidus, Evoroa began doing research on the strange technology the Exandrians had brought with them, sharing that information with the Volition. The last the Volition had heard from her, she and others were working on a device and/or weapon specifically for Ludinus. However, she was suddenly abducted by forces of the Imperium, and her cytaa Gona believed she had been taken beneath the Engineering Bay.
